_: Titles, descriptions and headings for every public page, written once. The web app (web/src/seo.ts) and the API (api/app/pages.py) both fill these in. `titles` are tried in order and the first that fits in 60 characters is used; descriptions are cut at 160.

titles: Binding of Isaac Synergy Builder for Repentance | {domain}
home.description: Pick your character, items and trinkets and see every known Binding of Isaac: Repentance synergy, what one more pickup unlocks, and an AI read. Free to use.
home.lede: Add what you're holding. Synergies show up as you go.

titles: All {items} Binding of Isaac Repentance Items | {domain}
items.description: Browse all {items} items in The Binding of Isaac: Repentance with quality, effects, stat changes and item pools. Open any item to see its known synergies.
items.lede: Every item in the game. Open one to see what it does and what it combines with.

titles: {name} Synergies in The Binding of Isaac | {domain}
item.description: {name} in The Binding of Isaac: Repentance: {effect}. Quality {quality}, {n} known {synergyWord}. Add it to your build.
item.answer: {name} has {n} known {synergyWord} in this list. The strongest {isAre} with {top}.
item.answerNone: The list has nothing for {name} yet. That is a gap in the list, not proof it combines with nothing.

titles: All {trinkets} Binding of Isaac Repentance Trinkets | {domain}
trinkets.description: Browse all {trinkets} trinkets in The Binding of Isaac: Repentance with their effects. Open any trinket to see what it combines with in your build.
trinkets.lede: Every trinket in the game. Open one to see what it does and what it combines with.

titles: {name} Trinket Synergies in The Binding of Isaac | {domain}
trinket.description: {name}, a Binding of Isaac: Repentance trinket: {effect}. {n} known {synergyWord}. Add it to your build.
trinket.answer: {name} has {n} known {synergyWord} in this list. The strongest {isAre} with {top}.
trinket.answerNone: The list has nothing for {name} yet. That is a gap in the list, not proof it combines with nothing.

titles: All {characters} Binding of Isaac Repentance Characters | {domain}
characters.description: All {characters} playable characters in The Binding of Isaac: Repentance with starting items and the synergies only they get. Pick one and start a build.
characters.lede: Some synergies only happen for one character. Open a character to see theirs.

titles: {name} Synergies and Starting Items | Binding of Isaac | {domain}
character.description: {name} in The Binding of Isaac: Repentance: starting items and {n} character-only {synergyWord}. Start a build as {name} to see what your items do.
character.answer: {name} has {n} character-only {synergyWord} in this list. The strongest {isAre} with {top}.
character.answerNone: Every general synergy still applies to {name}. The list just has nothing that is theirs alone.

titles: All {synergies} Binding of Isaac: Repentance Synergies | {domain}
synergies.description: {synergies} hand-written item, trinket and character synergies for The Binding of Isaac: Repentance, rated S to D. Search by item and open any in the builder.
synergies.lede: The whole list, strongest first. S is run-defining, A strong, B good, C minor, and D means the items work against each other.

titles: About {domain}: Data Sources, Ratings and AI Analysis
about.description: What {domain} is, where its Binding of Isaac item data comes from, how synergy ratings and the AI analysis work, and what happens to your data.

notFound.description: Nothing lives at this address on {domain}. Open the Binding of Isaac synergy builder or browse every item, trinket and character instead.

intro.heading: What does {domain} do?
intro.text: {domain} checks your character, items and trinkets against {synergies} hand-written synergies for {game}. It shows which ones apply, which single pickup would complete another, and can give an AI read on the whole build. It covers {items} items, {trinkets} trinkets and {characters} characters.

copy.examplesHeading: Start with what’s in your run
copy.examplesLede: Type an item’s name in the box, or open one of these to see how it works:
copy.startingItemsNote: Starting items come from the game’s own character table. Items the game hands out in code, such as an unlockable starting item, aren’t listed.
copy.noStartingItems: No items listed in the game's character table.
